current_task_corrections.correction: Change denial_rate component parameter denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude pending claims and correctly compute the rate over only resolved claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted).
The denial_rate value will be automatically corrected when the denominator parameter changes to 'adjudicated_claims', yielding the correct value of 1286 / 12339 = 0.1042.
Change monthly_trend component parameter date_column from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to capture when services occurred rather than when claims were processed.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Denial rates and other portfolio rates must use 'adjudicated_claims' as the denominator to exclude pending claims that have not yet been decided. Report both numerator and denominator values alongside the rate to demonstrate the definition.
Monthly trend series must key on service_date_from (when service occurred) rather than adjudication_date (when claim was processed) to accurately represent utilization patterns over time.
